title: Recruited into the GTE program and combat control
place_text: US Air Force; Lackland Air Force Base, Texas

tellings.quote: Yeah, so I ended up getting recruited to a brand new program that was called GTE,

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot, says that in 1994, during US Air Force training in Texas, he was recruited into a brand new programme he calls GTE, which he does not spell out. The story ties this to combat control, an Air Force special operations job on the ground. He tells it as an early step toward the secret missions he later describes.
